changes: Composer assigns distinct environment: and input-context: key namespaces to the coexisting picker siblings, so navigation removes the old instances.

useDraft creates a distinct visit object for each key transition; a layout-effect cleanup invalidates it before a different visit or unmount can accept events. Ordinary setters refuse an inactive visit or a mismatched current draft instead of falling back to emptyDraft. Returning A to B to A cannot reactivate callbacks captured on the first A visit. insertTextIfEmpty propagates refused admission. Loading through an old visit is also refused.

The original-draft removeAttachment path has separate mounted-instance ownership: if this hook instance remains mounted and currently shows the original key, deletion merges current in-memory content even after A to B to A navigation. After unmount it reads the latest stored original draft, merges only attachment removal, and broadcasts draftChanged without setting state on the old instance. Ordinary writes still update memory before persistence, preserving unsaved input when storage fails.

Added six meaningful regression cases in the existing composer.test.tsx and drafts.test.tsx files: real Composer plus useDraft navigation and delayed environment result; all ordinary setter ownership through A to B to A; empty-draft insert ownership; unmount admission plus allowed original-draft attachment cleanup; unmount then remount/edit followed by the old deletion; A to B to A late deletion with a quota-failed current in-memory draft. Existing storage-failure and late attachment tests remain passing.
